title: Levi bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Yehudah’s student. Sanhedrin 100a relates that Levi bar Shmuel and Rav Huna bar Chiyya were preparing wrappers for the books of Rav Yehudah’s study hall. When they reached the Scroll of Esther, they said that it did not need a wrapper. Rav Yehudah told them: “Even this looks like irreverence”—he was their teacher.
Megillah 19a likewise has him standing before Rav Yehudah.
Shabbat 47a says that he heard Rabbi Abba and Rav Huna bar Chiyya, who were standing at Rav Huna’s doorway. Levi bar Shmuel came before Rav Yehudah, etc.

notes.text: The parenthetical identification of Rav Yehudah and “he was their teacher” are Hyman’s own. The checked Shabbat passage explicitly names Rav Huna’s doorway.
The wrappers are wrappers for books or scrolls; the closing Shabbat episode names Rav Huna’s doorway.
